objective: Step-2 strict split and leakage-isolation policy for cross-lingual sockpuppet-account research

en_gold_benchmark.description: Strict English benchmark pool. Do not use for English content training.

en_content_train_pool.description: English content-training pool after strong identity-overlap exclusion and row-level CJK filtering.

zh_target_strict.description: Strict Chinese target-domain pool used for target evaluation and target-domain silver labels.

zh_target_aux.description: Chinese auxiliary target-domain pool kept outside strict target benchmark because market provenance is unresolved.

excluded.description: Rows or sellers excluded from the English content-training pool.

3z669jwe.sql.description: Auxiliary PGP identity evidence used to expand benchmark-linked alias and fingerprint closure.

html-rips.description: Local Grams InfoDesk vendor snapshots used to mine benchmark-linked high-precision contact identifiers from header regions.

normalization_rules.fingerprint_normalization: hex uppercase; short form normalized to 0x + last 16 hex chars
normalization_rules.contact_normalization: strict per-type normalization; non-email handle extraction ignores PGP public-key block content
normalization_rules.item_uid_rule: Use deterministic hash when no raw item id exists
normalization_rules.seller_uid_rule: Always scope by source_dataset and source_market_raw

exclusion_rules.logic: Exclude if normalized seller alias appears in the official EN-Gold alias ledger, including benchmark user_name and benchmark key_alias values
Exclude if seller alias maps via auxiliary PGP evidence to any fingerprint in the benchmark-linked identity closure
Exclude if row text contains a high-precision benchmark-linked contact identifier mined from local Grams header snapshots
Exclude if title, description, or category contains CJK characters

post_conditions: The normalized seller-alias overlap between en_content_train_pool and en_gold_benchmark must equal 0.
The auxiliary-PGP fingerprint overlap between en_content_train_pool and the benchmark-linked identity closure must equal 0.
Rows in zh_target_strict must come only from market_item.xlsx with market in {中文暗网交易市场, 茶马古道}.
products_data.csv must remain in zh_target_aux until market provenance is independently verified.
